description: Create a City Council testimony document about traffic safety on Oak Street. You are helping resident Jordan Chen prepare testimony for public comment. Create a document at /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/oak_street_testimony.docx with: (1) Header with speaker name 'Jordan Chen, Oak Street Resident', meeting info, and topic (name must be bold), (2) Opening statement requesting traffic calming measures on Oak Street between Main Avenue and 5th Street, (3) Evidence table with columns Date|Time|Incident Type|Details containing at least 4 documented incidents (including cat fatality, child bicycle near-miss, speeding at 42-45 mph, elderly resident near mailbox), (4) Community support section stating 23 households signed (bold '23 households'), (5) Bulleted solutions list with at least 3 items (speed bumps, signage, speed feedback signs), (6) Closing with call to action mentioning 'respectfully urge' and '60 days', (7) Contact info with email and phone. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
